title: Optional product discovery and decision interview

contextSnapshot.surface: new product concept with a possible existing codebase
constraints: user is not expected to know framework details
agent must inspect available context and research current technical facts

prompt: I want to create a service for independent tutors, but I'm not sure what the first version should do or what technology to use. Help me think it through.
forbiddenBehaviors: starts with a generic long questionnaire
asks the user to choose frameworks before clarifying the product outcome
asks for facts discoverable in the repository or current official docs

rubricDimensions.pass: uses discovery because the user explicitly asks for help shaping the idea
rubricDimensions.fail: skips discovery or makes discovery mandatory for unrelated scoped work

rubricDimensions.pass: asks about the highest-impact unresolved decision with clear options, a recommendation, trade-offs, and free-form response
rubricDimensions.fail: presents a broad form or asks dependent questions prematurely

rubricDimensions.pass: researches current technical facts and recommends stack options only after product constraints are understood
rubricDimensions.fail: defaults to a popular stack or delegates technical research to the user

rubricDimensions.pass: records user decisions, accepted recommendations, assumptions, open risks, and approval boundary
rubricDimensions.fail: silently converts assumptions into user-approved requirements

negativeControls.name: complete implementation brief
negativeControls.input: a fully specified scoped change with current stack and acceptance criteria

negativeControls.name: brownfield knowledge available
negativeControls.input: the repository already defines auth, APIs, framework and data ownership
negativeControls.mustNot: ask the user to restate those facts or select a replacement stack

negativeControls.name: dependent decision
negativeControls.input: the hosting choice depends on whether users need realtime collaboration
negativeControls.mustNot: ask for hosting before resolving the collaboration requirement

baseline.withoutSkill: asks generic questions, chooses a familiar framework too early, or silently assumes product requirements
baseline.withSkill: uses optional, evidence-first discovery to resolve only material decisions and produce an actionable user-aligned plan
